label: The CLI executor surface is eight named workflow executors (cli-opencode, cli-claude-code, cli-codex, cli-cursor, cli-devin, cli-pi, cli-deepseek-harness, cli-mistral-vibe), all packetKind workflow and backendKind cli-dispatch, and none is a slash command (command:null throughout).

The cli- prefix spans three homes: eight dispatch executors in cli-external-orchestration, the cli-jev transport as the single mode of the cli-classifier hub, and cli-orca as a standalone skill with no mode registry.

The MCP surface is eight modes split five workflow (chrome-devtools, click-up, aside-devtools, obsidian, notion) and three read-only transport (figma, refero, mobbin), across backend kinds cli-plus-mcp, code-mode-remote-mcp and figma-desktop-transport.
No mcp-tooling mode has a dedicated command; /doctor:mcp is the separate install/debug router covering every mcp-* skill.

Code Mode exposes four tools (call_tool_chain, list_tools, search_tools, tool_info) and is mandatory for all MCP tool calls; the 200+ tools and ~98% context-reduction figures are self-claims in its own frontmatter, not measurements.

The doctor family is 17 commands on disk (agents-md, ci, deep-loop, env, git, helper, install, mcp, overlay, runtime-mirrors, setup, sk-code, sk-skill, skill-advisor, speckit, symlink, update), not the ten setup commands the v4.0.2.0 notes describe.
The 44 commands break down as doctor 17, create 13, speckit 8, design 3, deep 2, prompt 1; assets/ and scripts/ hold no markdown, so 44 counts command documents only.

Correction: modes is a JSON array in all seven mode-registry.json files, not an object keyed by numeric index; lengths are 1,8,8,5,3,15,2 and the 42 total stands. jq keys on an array returns indices, which is what the earlier object description misread.

The eight CLI executors correspond by name one-to-one with the eight runtime adapter folders (claude-code/claude, codex, cursor, devin, deepseek-harness/dsh, opencode, pi, mistral-vibe/vibe), but no registry field declares the mapping.

The 15 skills split into 7 hubs with a mode registry (sk-doc, cli-external-orchestration, mcp-tooling, sk-code, sk-design, system-deep-loop, cli-classifier) and 8 standalone skills (cli-orca, local-webflow, mcp-code-mode, sk-git, sk-prompt, system-skill-advisor, system-skilled-doctor, system-spec-kit).
No cli-external-orchestration or mcp-tooling mode carries a dedicated slash command; both hubs route by advisor metadata and resolve the mode at hub level.
